interface.signature: name: list[str], city: str, state: str -> str

preconditions.expression: isinstance(name, list) and all(isinstance(n, str) for n in name) and len(name) >= 1
preconditions.description: The 'name' parameter must be a non-empty list of strings.
The 'city' parameter must be a non-empty string.
The 'state' parameter must be a non-empty string.

postconditions.description: The output must be a formatted string greeting the person and welcoming them to the specified city and state.
